text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 30% opacity glow at 4px spread. This balances visibility for keyboard users with reduced visual clutter for screen reader users. The glow widens the focus indicator without adding bulk, making it easier to spot on complex backgrounds. Trade-off: the glow may slightly obscure adjacent elements, but the 2px ring keeps the impact minimal.

name: Reader
text: The 2px solid ring with 30% glow risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds where the glow blends in. A 3px solid ring with no glow works better—clear at all zoom levels, no blur risk, and still thin enough for mobile. Test it on high-contrast and patterned backgrounds to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with no glow. It stays crisp on patterned backgrounds and at high zoom levels, meeting WCAG’s 3:1 contrast requirement without blur artifacts. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s still thin enough for mobile and doesn’t add visual noise. Test it on high-contrast and patterned backgrounds to confirm clarity.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring risks feeling heavy on mobile touch targets where space is tight. A 2.5px ring with a subtle 15% glow at 2px spread keeps crispness without bulk—test it on both patterned backgrounds and touch screens to confirm.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2.5px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 15% opacity glow at 2px spread. Result: A tested, accessible focus indicator for EXCAVA. Owner: accessibility-w1.
